title: What is one half?
examples: Are both halves the same size?
How do I find half of 8?

explain.say: You and a friend want to share one roti, and it must be fair. Look at the board: one round roti cut into 2 equal parts. The shaded part is one half.
Now both parts are shaded: 2 halves make the whole roti again. Half means one of 2 equal parts, and equal means exactly the same size. Can you see the line down the middle?
Halves are not just for round things. Here is a chocolate bar cut into 2 equal parts, with one half shaded. We write it 1 over 2. The 2 tells you how many equal parts. What does the 1 tell you?
You can find half of a group too. 8 grapes shared between 2 people gives 4 each. So half of 8 is 4. See the two equal groups? What is half of 6?

Super! Remember: if the 2 parts are not the same size, they are not halves. Wow: your body has two halves too, with an eye, an ear and an arm on each side! Challenge: fold a paper in half in two different ways.

faq.a: Half means one of 2 equal parts. If you cut an apple into 2 pieces that are exactly the same size, each piece is one half.

faq.q: Are both halves the same size?
faq.a: Yes, always. If one piece is bigger, the pieces are not halves. Halves must be equal.

faq.q: How do I find half of 8?
faq.a: Share 8 into 2 equal groups. Each group has 4, so half of 8 is 4.

faq.q: How do I write one half?
faq.a: Write 1 over 2, with a line between them. The 2 at the bottom means 2 equal parts, and the 1 on top means you have one of them.

faq.q: How many halves make a whole?
faq.a: 2 halves make one whole. Put both halves of the roti back together and you have the whole roti.

facts: Half of an even number is a whole number: half of 8 is 4.

quiz.say: A pizza is cut into 2 pieces that are not the same size. Are they halves?
quiz.show: A pizza is cut into 2 pieces that are not the same size. Are they halves?
quiz.why: Halves must be exactly the same size.

wrong.0: Having 2 pieces is not enough; they must be equal.
wrong.1: If one piece is bigger, they are not equal, so they are not halves.

quiz.why: 10 shared into 2 equal groups is 5 each.

wrong.1: 2 is the number of groups, not how many are in each.
